constraint_set.description: The conditions this pattern is actually known to apply under -- e.g. ['python', 'docker-multi-container']. Empty means unconstrained, stated explicitly, never implied by omission.

evidence_level.description: Same vocabulary as verification_contract.py's SubClaim -- reused, not reinvented.

abstracted.description: True once abstract_claim() has stripped proprietary specifics. A global-scope entry with any provenance row abstracted=false is invalid -- enforced, not just documented.

related_pattern_ids.description: Free relational seam, added proactively per the pattern-learning-architecture-design.md 'cheap seam now, expensive engine later' decision -- no graph query engine exists yet. Populated manually when a real multi-hop relationship between two patterns is observed; empty means none recorded, never implies none exist.

status.description: candidate: surfaced, no disposition yet. confirmed: a real reversal proved it mattered. promoted: confirmed in >=2 distinct projects, abstracted, eligible for global scope. retired: superseded or proven wrong -- kept, never deleted, for the same reason nothing in this codebase deletes a real record.
